messages:
tess: Heads up — noticed sensitive headers (user email) leaking to logs and traces during sampleapp onboarding. Redaction middleware runs but the X-Request-Id and email still show up in stdout and in otel span.attributes. Repro below.

kevin: oh no. which redaction middleware and where in the boot order is it mounted? otel auto-instrumentation can capture headers before app middleware runs.

tess: boot order: config -> init logger -> init otel auto-instrumentation -> express app -> app.use(redactMiddleware) -> routes. redactMiddleware removes X-User-Email and masks auth tokens. Code:```js
// redact.js
module.exports = (req,res,next)=>{ delete req.headers['x-user-email']; if(req.headers['authorization']) req.headers['authorization'] = 'REDACTED'; next(); }```

sam: yep that explains it. OTEL http instrumentation reads headers at request start (before your middleware). It stores them in span.attributes which some of our log formatting includes via trace context. So even though you delete headers later they're already captured.

lee: can you share the small log/traces showing the leak?

tess: example from local run:```
INFO  maya-service request received { method: 'POST', path: '/api/login', reqId: 'r-123', userEmail: 'dev@example.com' }
otel span attributes: { http.method: 'POST', http.target: '/api/login', http.request.header.x-user-email: 'dev@example.com' }
```
Both show the email.

kevin: two approaches: 1) Mount redaction middleware as the very first middleware (and start it before otel registers), 2) configure otel http instrumentation to ignore headers or provide a header sanitizer, 3) if neither possible, surgically remove sensitive span attributes in a span processor.

sam: config tip: in OpenTelemetry Node you can supply httpInstrumentation.disableHeaders or set request hook to remove attributes. Example:```js
const httpInstrumentation = new HttpInstrumentation({ requestHook: (span, request) => { // scrub headers here } });
registerInstrumentations({ instrumentations: [httpInstrumentation] });
```

tess: tried moving redact middleware earlier but because otel auto-inits at require time it still captured headers. Starting otel after redaction works locally but messy. We should document recommended boot order for sampleapp: init redaction helper before OTEL init or set OTEL requestHook.

lee: for DX docs: recommend sampleapp scaffold to attach a tiny pre-handler (process.env.SCRUB_HEADERS=true) and show how to configure otel requestHook. Also show how to avoid logging span attributes in pretty printers.

kevin: I'll add a small doc snippet and a unit smoke test that asserts no sensitive headers in span attributes after a request. CI can catch regressions.

ci-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-3384: "Telemetry/Redaction: OTEL captures headers before app-level redaction -> secrets leak to logs/spans" https://tracker/redwood/DEVEX-3384

tess: Created PR with reproducible test + doc updates: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/92. Temporary fix in PR sets httpInstrumentation.requestHook to scrub headers.

sam: good short-term fix. Long-term we should move away from auto-capturing all headers by default; docs + sampleapp should default to safe config.

lee: agree. Also add an onboarding note: "If you see sensitive values in logs/traces, check boot order and OTEL requestHook first."

tess: thanks team — will update PR with the checklist and close DEVEX-3384 once infra verifies the test on staging.
